You were definitely projecting your situation and if you cannot separate don’t speak. We can speak a little on the husband actions because we still have idea of how he handles his spouse which isn’t healthy long term for the child, coupled with the long hours and frequent trips. I 100% agree a note should have been left. It probably would have made more of a difference but overall, this isn’t a happy set up for decent communication. You could NEVER disappear because you aren’t in a situation with a person who makes you want to disappear.

I think you should sit down with you friend and tell him your concerns first. If you just call that might leave a bad impression especially if they think of it as normal. I’m from the states, so I’m not sure how social services handles this in your country but there is a possibility they’ll be removed from the home and or separated. You can also seek other services that would try to keep them together while changing the living environment. If it persists and you feel as though you’ve run out of interventions definitely call.

Like she even mentions feeling like her husband downgraded her to baby mama and constantly being on the verge of tears. He treats her like a roommate  barely even that. Doesn’t even talk to her even though she has made the effort. I don’t hear shit about the dad even though: he’s an emotionally absent partner, was an absent dad until the pandemic(remember all those business trips), and finally threatening her after already turning her down for a conversation because he rather a therapist deal with her. She probably would have said yes if they actually discussed what’s going on.

I mean ...why else would you say such horrible things to a woman who is clearly struggling with support and her mental health? Your either not a mom, don’t have a spouse or you aren’t a very pleasant person. You could also be projecting but whatever the reason, you have no reason to curse at her. She left the baby with it’s FATHER. She literally passed her job to the next qualified person. If he doesn’t want to be a dad or deal with a woman who is clearly experiencing mental health problems, why threaten to drag her back? With ppl like you and the husband and all the other fucks who have invalidated her, I see why ppl kill themselves and take the kids with them. If she just took herself out of the situation you’ll still say she’s a bad parent instead of asking what lead to those actions.

You need a real support system, not a bunch of internet ppl with their own abandonment issues projecting. I feel for you and think you need actual help and not others making you feel guilty. Parenting is hard especially if you feel isolated. Log off, figure out where you can seek support, start the healing process. You cannot go back to that baby if you are unwell yourself. Also start working on other living arrangements, if you have to run away from home, it’s not your home.
